name: Voymastina

skills.name: Dread Ultimatum
skills.description: Selects an enemy target within a 8 tile radius and deals Physical damage equivalent to 80% ATK to it

skills.name: Mastiff's Vow
skills.description:
Voymastina is immune to movement displacement and movement debuffs, does not receive protection from Cover, but reduces damage taken by 30%. When Stability is more than 0, reduces damage taken by 80% instead

When dealing Physical damage, ignores 50% of the target's DEF. After using active skills or basic attack, increases Confectance Index by 2 points. If Confectance Index is at max, consumes all of it and gains Predation Protocol

fortification.effect:
Increases damage multiplier to 180% ATK, increases Stability damage dealt by 2 points, increases effect area by 2 tiles

Passive: Increases damage multiplier to 150% ATK, increases Stability damage dealt by 1 point, increases effect area by 2 tiles

Before triggering the active or passive effects of this skill, increases ATK by 10% for 1 round (Duration decreases at the end of the current round), and applies Frightened on the target for 2 round (Duration decreases at the end of the current round)

Wolf Eye System: Increases duration by 1 round (Duration decreases at the end of the current round), increases damage multiplier to 130% ATK, and removes the maximum trigger limit per round. If an enemy is spawned within Attack Range, deals targeted damage equivalent to 130% ATK and 1 Stability to the target

Passive: Increases damage multiplier to 300% ATK, increases number of targets to 10, and applies Stun for 1 turn after attack

Before triggering the active or passive effects of this skill, applies Dismay on the target for 2 rounds
New effect is added for Passive - When performing any Action Support, gains 1 stack of Coordinated Hunting

Increases damage multplier to 300%. If Voymastina has Predation Protocol, increases ATK by 30%

Before triggering the active or passive effects of this skill, applies Defense Down II for 2 turns

Increases movement speed by 2 tiles

At the start of the battle, gains Pursuer. For each round, if Voymastina used 2 or more active skills or their passive effects, gains Pursuer or refreshes its duration. For each Action Support performed, gains 1 stack of Hunting Rhythm

When Voymastina's ATK is increased, her DEF is increased by 50% of the corresponding ATK increase value, up to a maximum of 30% of her initial DEF. When dealing Physical damage, ignores 125% of the target's DEF

keys.name: Fixed Key 1
keys.effect: Howl from the Firmament: If this skill or its passive effect hit a boss enemy or 3 or more enemies, gains Quick Barrier

keys.name: Fixed Key 2
keys.effect: Pile Bunker: After triggering the passive effect of this skill, gains Movement Up II for 2 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 3
keys.effect: The range of all Action Support is extended to the entire field, and deals 30% more damage towards non boss enemies

keys.name: Fixed Key 4
keys.effect: Howl from the Firmament: If this skill or its passive effect only hits 1 enemy, increases damage dealt by 20% and Stability damage dealt by 2 points

keys.name: Fixed Key 5
keys.effect: Before attacking, gains Reversed Assault for 3 turns

keys.name: Fixed Key 6
keys.effect: Pile Bunker: After being attacked, the next usage of this skill deals 15% more damage

keys.name: Common Key
keys.effect: ATK +5% / When dealing melee damage, increases Physical damage dealt by 10% for 1 round (Duration decreases at the end of the current round)
